title: Onboarding · round 2
intro: Claude Design, 23 Nov. Your two notes on r1: some users need no editor; the promo should sell a personal workshop, not features. r1 stands except where r2 changes it.

Editor A · no editor until you need one: first run asks nothing, new installs start with both editors off (no Code in the rail). The first Review changes opens a read-only diff in Agents with a one-time row: turn on Neovim to comment on lines. nvim config import only appears where Neovim is turned on.

Positioning A · "Your workshop. Claude Code is the crew." Hero = the Home workspace answering "What waits for me today?" across projects, backlog, cron and wiki; the phone holds the one thing that needs you. Worktrees, checkpoints and land gates move into the README.
About (106): "Your personal workshop on the Mac: you and your Claude Code agents, on every project and on your own life."
